title: Testing out BFBC2-like destruction with Three.js + Opus 5.5
author: freakspace99
selftext:
Just a quick test to see if BFBC2-like destruction is viable with Three.js.

Considering it was a one-shot, i think the result is pretty good.

  
Made by Opus 5.5

comments.author: Double_Suggestion385
comments.body: Nice, one of the best games ever.

replies.author: freakspace99
replies.body: It's a custom, deterministic plank-based destruction system Opus 5.5 wrote, using three-mesh-bvh for raycasting, Rapier only for cosmetic flying debris, and three-bvh-csg only for the rejected solid-wall comparison.
